title: Nothing’s Earbuds 3A Didn’t Wow Me, but They’re Still a Good Value
summary: The Ear 3A are the definition of solid-but-unspectacular noise-canceling earbuds and are a good alternative to more premium options like the AirPods Pro 3 or Samsung’s Galaxy Buds 4 Pro (Samsung’s likable Galaxy Buds 3 FE are its version of A-series buds).
